--- LEARNING OBJECTIVES & CAN-DO STATEMENTS ---

--- LANGUAGE FUNCTIONS & TARGET REPERTOIRE ---
[Language Function: Expressing Opinions and Personal Viewpoints]
  Model Expressions:
    - "I think robotics class is the most exciting subject of the week."
    - "In my opinion, playing outside is better than watching TV all day."
    - "I don't think homework on weekends is necessary."
    - "What do you think about the new school library?"
    - "In my opinion, students benefit from flexible learning hours because it promotes self-discipline."
    - "I believe that online resources make studying more accessible, though hands-on practice is still essential."
    - "From my point of view, social media has both significant advantages and clear drawbacks."
    - "As far as I am concerned, ethical oversight of automated systems is indispensable in educational technology."
    - "It seems to me that technological adoption must be paired with active digital wellbeing protocols."
    - "I am firmly convinced that experiential project work outweighs mere theoretical memorization."
  Pedagogical Guidance:

--- GRAMMAR PROGRESSION & STRUCTURES ---
• Focus: Modal Verbs of Deduction and Possibility in the Present: Must, Might, May, Could, Can't
• Focus: Present Perfect Continuous: Ongoing Activities, Duration and Visible Present Results
• Focus: Non-Defining Relative Clauses: Adding Extra Information and Punctuation Conventions
• Focus: Reported Speech: Statements, Backshift, Pronoun Changes and Indirect Questions
• Focus: Conditionals Progression: Real, Hypothetical, Unreal and Mixed Scenarios
• Focus: Logical and Discourse Connectors: Contrast, Cause, Result and Concession
• Focus: Passive Voice in Academic and Technical Discourse
  - **Prueba del Paréntesis:** Si al eliminar la proposición entre comas el enunciado principal conserva su sentido identificador pleno, la cláusula es *non-defining*.
  - **Error Crítico Frecuente:** Mantener la estructura de pregunta en el estilo indirecto (*"She asked where did I go"* ❌ → *"She asked where I had gone"* ✅).
  - **Foco en el Significado, no sólo en la Fórmula:** Contrastar el impacto pragmático de elegir `will`, `would` o `might` en la cláusula de resultado.
  - **Práctica Situacional:** Juegos de simulación de crisis ("What if scenario challenges") donde los alumnos justifican decisiones de contingencia.
  - **Error Común Crítico:** Evitar la confusión de régimen entre `Despite + clause` (incorrecto) vs `Despite + noun/gerund` (correcto) o `Despite the fact that + clause`.
  - **Ejercicios de Unión de Oraciones:** Fusionar pares de oraciones aisladas en un solo enunciado elegante de nivel preuniversitario.
  - **Uso Crítico de la Frase "by":** Enseñar que la frase con `by [agente]` sólo se incluye cuando el agente aporta información indispensable para la comprensión del enunciado.
  - **Transformación de Reportes Experimentales:** Convertir notas de laboratorio personales (*"We mixed the solutions"*) a lenguaje científico formal (*"The solutions were carefully combined"*).
